## Architecture summary
This is a Spring Boot 4.1 / Spring MVC app. The REST **DTOs and API interfaces are generated at build time** by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (model suffix `Dto`, into `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto` / `.rest.api`). MapStruct maps DTO↔entity. Persistence is JPA via Spring Data (`spring-data-jpa` profile active in both prod and tests); the DB schema is created from `schema.sql` scripts, **not** Hibernate DDL. There is no `City` entity — `city` is a plain `String`, and "region" is a lookup table.

## 1. Owner entity
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- `@Entity @Table(name="owners")`, extends `Person` (which holds `firstName`/`lastName`).
- Persisted fields: `address`, `city` (both `@NotEmpty String`), `telephone` (`@NotEmpty @Pattern ^\+[0-9]{8,15}$`), `email`, `registrationDate`, `customerCode`, `householdId`, `namesakeCount`, `householdSize`, `bulkSignupWarning`, plus `pets`.
- To add postcode: add `@Column(name="postcode") private String postcode;` with getter/setter (and include in `toString` if desired).

## 2. Owner DTO / request classes (generated — edit the spec, not Java)
Defined in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`:
- **`OwnerFields`** schema (lines ~1991-2063) → generates `OwnerFieldsDto`, the **create/update request body**. Contains `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city` (string, minLength 1, maxLength 80), `telephone`, `email`, `registrationDate`, `sharesHousehold`. `required: firstName,lastName,address,city,telephone`.
- **`Owner`** schema (lines ~2064-2178) → `OwnerDto` (response). `allOf: OwnerFields + {id, displayName, initials, customerCode, ..., locality, contactPreference, bulkSignupWarning, pets}`. Because it composes `OwnerFields`, any non-readOnly field added to `OwnerFields` (like `postcode`) is automatically returned on GET.
- Generated sources land in `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` (added as a source root by build-helper plugin).

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneDigits"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same
            last name and address (i.e. they share a household). Write-only request flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners that belong to the same household (same last
                name and address). Present only for owners created with 'sharesHousehold' set.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key used for duplicate detection, formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners are
                duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed when this owner was created sharing the
                same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32

## Summary

I implemented optional, city-region-validated `postcode` support for owners:

**Validation (the core rule)**
- `util/PostcodePolicy.java` — new. Holds the fixed region→postcode-range table (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099) and decides validity for a city, reusing the existing `LocalityResolver` for city→region lookup. Unknown region ⇒ any 4-digit postcode accepted.
- `rest/validation/ValidPostcodeForCity.java` + `...Validator.java` — new class-level Bean Validation constraint on the request DTO. It skips when postcode is absent or not 4 digits (format is the field pattern's job) and otherwise delegates the range check to `PostcodePolicy`, reporting the violation on the `postcode` field. Mirrors the existing `TelephoneDigits` validator pattern.

**API contract**
- `openapi.yml` — added optional `postcode` to `OwnerFields` (`pattern: ^[0-9]{4}$` gives the malformed-→400 for free) and stamped the class-level `@ValidPostcodeForCity` on the schema via `x-class-extra-annotation`. Because `Owner` composes `OwnerFields`, postcode is returned on GET automatically.

**Persistence & wiring**
- `model/Owner.java` — added the `postcode` column + accessors.
- `OwnerRestControllerV1.updateOwner` — added `setPostcode(...)` (the create path already maps it via MapStruct name-matching).
- Added a `postcode` column to all four `schema.sql` dialects (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres).

Each piece sits in its own small unit: format validation stays in the field constraint, the city↔postcode business rule lives in `PostcodePolicy`, and the resolver table is reused rather than duplicated. The three new acceptance tests (`coreStoresValidPostcode`, `coreAcceptsOwnerWithoutPostcode`, `errorRejectsMalformedPostcode`) all pass.
